newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market higher in strong rally.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market higher in strong rally.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed higher on Wednesday under continuing buying pressure from several foreign funds, mainly on blue chips.
Traders said oil refineries and cement makers had been in great demand at Wednesday's session. They were seen continuing to attract investor interest throughout the week.
On Wednesday, gainers led decliners 138 to 69, with 294 stocks remaining unchanged.
Three independent indices computed by securities companies based on average prices and market capitalisation climbed from the previous session.
The VAB-RA all-share index was up four percent to 5,221.9 points, BIG-OTC rose by 5.01 percent to 4,156.37 and CAS-RQ grew 4.13 percent to 939 points.
Favourite listing Arpechim oil refinery picked up 2,500 lei to at 40,000, while Petrobrazi, another refinery, gained 5,000 lei to end 51,500.
Cement maker Romcim firmed 20,000 at 130,000 and Moldocim, another cement maker, was 3,000 lei stronger at 45,500.
Turnover on Wednesday rose some 4.6 billion lei to 32.3 billion lei, while volume was 5.3 million shares, slightly up from 5.2 million previously.
